input: Purpose: temporary MoodX pitch-deck concept background testing the image-generation pipeline. Subject: an abstract flowing emotional spectrum formed from translucent layered ribbons and soft particles. Composition: cinematic wide 16:9 frame with generous uncluttered negative space on the left for a title; visual energy gathers toward the right without crowding the frame. Style and lighting: polished cinematic editorial lighting, deep near-black plum background, acid-lime and violet highlights matching the existing MoodX deck, refined depth, subtle glow, calm and optimistic mood. Constraints: no people, no faces, no logos, no text, no typography, no user interface, no medical imagery.
